role.zh: 博士后 · 人文地理学

institution.en: Institute of Geographic Sciences and Natural Resources Research, Chinese Academy of Sciences
institution.zh: 中国科学院地理科学与资源研究所

intro.en: I study how urban and rural settlements evolve, and what these changes mean for ecosystems and environmental sustainability. My research connects settlement mapping with the ecological consequences of land-use change, from regional patterns to global comparisons.
intro.zh: 我关注城乡聚落如何演变，以及这些变化如何影响生态系统与环境可持续性。研究将城乡聚落空间识别与土地利用变化的生态环境效应相结合，从区域过程走向全球比较。

bio.en: I am a postdoctoral researcher in human geography at the Institute of Geographic Sciences and Natural Resources Research, Chinese Academy of Sciences, working with Prof. Chuanglin Fang. I received my Ph.D. in Human Geography from the University of Chinese Academy of Sciences in 2025, and my bachelor's degree in Human Geography and Urban–Rural Planning from Sun Yat-sen University in 2020.
bio.zh: 我现为中国科学院地理科学与资源研究所人文地理学博士后，合作导师为方创琳研究员。2025年获中国科学院大学人文地理学博士学位，2020年本科毕业于中山大学人文地理与城乡规划专业。

text.en: Mapping settlement patterns and comparing the spatial and temporal dynamics of urban and rural expansion.
text.zh: 识别城乡聚落空间格局，比较城市与乡村扩张的时空特征及响应机制。

title.zh: 土地变化与生态环境效应

text.en: Understanding how settlement expansion affects biodiversity, ecosystem services and the ecological environment.
text.zh: 理解聚落扩张对生物多样性、生态系统服务和生态环境的影响，探索级联耦合机制。

text.en: Exploring urban resilience, environmental governance and integrated frameworks for tracking sustainability.
text.zh: 研究城市韧性与环境治理，探索追踪地球可持续性的综合分析框架。
